claims.text: The resort rises from the slopes of Sulphur Mountain, above the forest canopy.

findings.quote: Rimrock Banff, Emblems Collection rises from the slopes of Sulphur Mountain
Above the forest canopy, where mountain air runs clear

claims.text: The resort is surrounded by Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

findings.quote: a retreat surrounded by the wild expanse of Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site

claims.text: Rimrock Banff is the first Emblems Collection hotel in North America.

findings.quote: As the first Emblems Collection hotel in North America, The Rimrock Banff is shaped by nature

claims.text: The resort sits above the valley, moments from Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola.

findings.quote: Nestled above the valley and just moments from Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola

claims.text: The resort is just over 1.5 hours west of Calgary International Airport.

findings.quote: Just over 1.5 hours west of Calgary International Airport

claims.text: Premium Forest View rooms have views of Mount Rundle and the Bow Valley.

findings.quote: Featuring sweeping views of Mount Rundle and the incredible Bow Valley, these Premium Forest View guest rooms offer upscale design elements and curated amenities.

claims.text: Parker's Table is the signature restaurant, celebrating Canadian terroir.

findings.quote: Parker’s Table is the signature dining experience at Rimrock Banff, a celebration of Canadian terroir and the true North.

findings.quote: Craft beers and cocktails flow from the taps, signature plates and house made gelato make their rounds, and seasonal programming keeps the space lively, from happy hour to fireside Bombardino evenings.

findings.quote: With our Aurora Wake-Up Call, you can sign up to be notified if the northern lights make an appearance during your stay. Our team will give you a call and wake you up

findings.quote: #### Infinity Two Bedroom Suite
this elevated, top-level suite is a home away from home featuring upscale amenities, fine furnishings, and an expansive balcony overlooking the Rockies.

findings.quote: #### Mountain Goat Adventures
